Police Detail Alleged Premeditated Murder Plot in Ketan Agarwal Case

Police are investigating the alleged murder of Ketan Agarwal, with a focus on the actions of Sia Goyal and her alleged accomplice, Chetan Chaudhary. Investigators claim Goyal signaled Chaudhary to push Agarwal, leading to his death. The investigation has involved recreating the crime scene and questioning family members, with reports suggesting a pre-planned strategy and potential alternate plans for the murder.
